from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A judgment document with its type, case cause, and relevant criminal classification."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document title as named in the case")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document: criminal, civil, or administrative")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The 案由 as explicitly stated in the document")
    specific_charges: list[str] = Field(description="Specific criminal charges named, if any (empty list if civil/administrative)")
    falls_under_social_administration_crime: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the charges belong to '妨害社会管理秩序罪' chapter, inferred from document summary")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
